items.text: Haiwa Jehovha, ndicharamba ndichidanidzira, ndichitsvaka rubatsiro kusvikira riniko,
Kuparadza nokuita nechisimba zviri pamberi pangu;
pano kukakavara, uye kurwa kuri kuwanda.
Nokuti ndichaita chimwe chinhu pamazuva ako
ruya rudzi rune utsinye, rune hasha,
kuti rubvute nzvimbo dzokugara dzisiri dzavo.
Mapoka avo ehondo anouya semhepo inovhuvhuta mugwenga
varume vane mhosva, simba ravo ndiye mwari wavo."
Haiwa Jehovha, ko hamugari nokusingaperi here?
Meso enyu akachena zvokuti haangatarisi zvakaipa;
Sei makaita kuti vanhu vave sehove dzegungwa,
Ko, acharamba achingodurura zviri mumumbure wake,

items.text: Nokuti chiratidzo ichi chakamirira nguva yakatarwa;
"Ko, vakatapwa vose havangazomuseki here nezvirahwe zvokumushora vachiti,
makaparadza nyika namaguta pamwe chete navageremo.
"Ane nhamo anovaka umambo hwake nepfuma yakabiwa,
ipapo matanda edenga remba achadairira namaungira.
Tarirai, hazvina kubva kuna Jehovha Wamasimba Ose here
uye kuti marudzi avanhu anongozvinetesa nezvisina maturo?
Nokuti nyika yose ichazadzwa nokuziva kubwinya kwaJehovha,
achizvidurura kubva mumatende ewaini kusvikira vadhakwa,
Mukombe unobva kuruoko rwaJehovha rworudyi uri kuuya kwamuri,
Nokuti kuita nechisimba kwamakaitira Rebhanoni kuchakukundai,
makaparadza nyika namaguta navose vakanga vageremo!
Asi Jehovha ari mutemberi yake tsvene;
nyika yose ngairambe inyerere pamberi pake."

Ko, makanga matsamwira nzizi here, nhai Jehovha?
Makanga matsamwira zvikova here, nhai Jehovha?
Nepfumo rake chairo makabaya musoro wake,
ndichava nomufaro muna Mwari Muponesi wangu.
